model_type: XGBoost classifier (sklearn Pipeline: ColumnTransformer preprocessing -> XGBClassifier)
load_instructions: import joblib; pipe = joblib.load('vendorshield_model_v1.joblib'); proba = pipe.predict_proba(df)[:, 1]  # df must be a pandas DataFrame with exactly the input_fields below, in any column order

input_fields.name: vendor_category
input_fields.notes: one of 12 categories; unseen categories are handled gracefully (encoded as all-zero)

input_fields.name: unit_of_measure
input_fields.notes: one of: pallet, kg, meter, unit, carton, litre, roll, box

input_fields.name: payment_method
input_fields.notes: one of: RTGS, Bank Transfer, Cheque, NEFT, UPI

input_fields.name: unit_price
input_fields.notes: actual price paid per unit on this purchase

input_fields.name: vendor_tenure_days_at_purchase
input_fields.notes: purchase_date minus vendor registration_date, in days

input_fields.name: vendor_historical_avg_price
input_fields.notes: leave-one-out average of this vendor's unit_price for this product across other purchases

input_fields.name: price_deviation_ratio
input_fields.notes: unit_price / vendor_historical_avg_price, winsorized at the 99th percentile (cap ~28.19) before scoring

input_fields.name: is_suspected_shell_vendor
input_fields.notes: 1 if vendor shares bank_account_number or tax_id with another vendor_id

input_fields.name: is_round_invoice
input_fields.notes: 1 if invoice_amount lands exactly on a 1000 or 5000 boundary

exclusion_reasons.fraud_reason: ground-truth explanation of the label; using it would leak the answer
exclusion_reasons.shell_cluster_id: ground-truth shell-ring ID, not available/knowable at real scoring time; use is_suspected_shell_vendor instead
exclusion_reasons.identifiers (purchase_id, vendor_id, etc: high-cardinality IDs with no generalizable signal; safe to pass through as metadata but keep out of the model input dict
exclusion_reasons.raw dates: superseded by the pre-computed day-count features (days_to_pay, days_purchase_to_invoice, etc.); pass dates upstream and compute the day-counts before calling the model

output_schema.fraud_probability: float, 0.0-1.0, model's raw predicted probability of fraud
output_schema.risk_level: string, one of 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low', derived by thresholding fraud_probability against risk_bands above
output_schema.top_reasons: list of strings (up to 3), plain-language SHAP-derived explanations of the top features pushing this transaction's score toward fraud, ordered by contribution size

top_reasons: invoice amount differs from purchase amount by 7.1%
invoice amount is a suspiciously round number
unit price of ₹1,400.00 is unusually high
